verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official MCP server for AI agents. Its svelte-autofixer tool 'analyzes Svelte code and returns issues and suggestions', and the server statically analyses agent-generated code, so this is first-party AI-oriented code analysis that returns suggestions. The evidence never says it analyzes the component tree or targets rendering/reactivity performance, so it only glancingly meets the story. Missing for 10: component-tree-level analysis, explicit rendering/reactivity optimization suggestions, runtime/devtools profiling integration, hands-on corroboration.
